question: What is the total percentage of the Christian population according to the 2011 Census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.3 percent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 15th Census of India and the 7th Census of Independent India-2011 was started on 1st April 2010.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was ‘Our Census, Our future’. 
 
• As per census- 2011 total population of India was 1,210,854,977.
 
• Most populous-Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Least populous-Sikkim.​
